role: XCUITest of the first-run path: the health disclaimer gates a fresh install, accepting it reveals onboarding, and an all-skip walk of onboarding reaches the app.

units.does: Sets continueAfterFailure=false and launches with -UITests, -UITests-FreshInstall and English; does not walk gates.
units.entry: XCTest runner: setUp before each test in the class

units.does: Releases the XCUIApplication (app = nil); does not terminate the app.
units.entry: XCTest runner: tearDown after each test in the class

units.does: Asserts the 'Health Disclaimer' heading or disclaimer.agree appears; if a tab bar exists, coordinate-taps its More tab (tapSafely) and asserts the More menu's Settings row does not appear within 4 s and the disclaimer's agree button is still there — reachability checked by the tap's effect, since a covered tab bar reports hittable on iOS 26.
units.entry: XCTest runner: test method on an XCTestCase subclass

branches.effect: tap More and assert it did not open and the disclaimer stayed; else no tab assertion

units.does: Asserts disclaimer.agree appears, swipes the first scroll view up to 6 times until enabled, asserts it is enabled, taps it, then asserts 'Welcome to Emuqu' text, 'Get started' or 'Next' button appears.
units.entry: XCTest runner: test method on an XCTestCase subclass

branches.cond: for up to 6 swipes while agree disabled

units.does: Accepts the disclaimer if possible, then for up to 12 iterations taps the laid-out onboarding.skip (recording that a skip was seen) or onboarding.advance, ending when neither exists and a tab bar exists; the app counts as reached only if UITestLaunch.toMainUI then confirms no gate (paywall included) is up and the tab bar takes taps; asserts a skip was seen and the app was reached.
units.entry: XCTest runner: test method on an XCTestCase subclass

branches.effect: try to enable and accept it

branches.cond: for up to 6 swipes while disabled
neither control exists and a tab bar exists
branches.effect: reachedApp=true, break; else wait up to 2s for any text
also requires UITestLaunch.toMainUI (dismisses the paywall, true only with no gate up and a tappable tab bar)

units.does: Test helper: from one allElementsBoundByIndex snapshot of buttons with `identifier`, the first that is enabled and UITestFind.isSafelyHittable (a real frame inside the app), skipping the zero-frame copies a paged TabView keeps for neighbouring pages; nil when none.
